definition: The approximate state of a hurt creature, told from its current and maximum hit points and from nothing else, so that every place that shows how hurt a creature is agrees. Hit points are whole numbers and the maximum is at least 1; a current figure outside 0 to the maximum is read as the nearest bound. The band is `mort` when the current hit points are 0: death is this band, never a separate flag to keep in step. Above 0, it is `indemne` when they equal the maximum, `blessé` when they are above half of the maximum (twice the current is more than the maximum), and `en sang` when they are at half of the maximum or less (twice the current is at most the maximum). 0 is a value, not an absence: a creature at 0 hit points is `mort`. A creature whose hit points are not tracked, such as a player character's token that carries neither `hp_current` nor `hp_max`, has no band: `band` is null, a key that is absent and a key that is null being the same input. A band is derived only when both figures are present; one without the other gives null. The output is the band alone and never carries a hit point figure, so whoever shows it shows how hurt a creature is without telling how many hit points it has.

band.rule: null when hp_current or hp_max is absent or null; otherwise, with hp_current read within 0 and hp_max: `mort` at 0, `indemne` at hp_max, `blessé` when 2 × hp_current > hp_max, `en sang` when 2 × hp_current ≤ hp_max
